post.title: Myth: crypto yield is just like savings account interest
post.ig:
Crypto yield is just like savings interest? Not even close.
Jan 2022: Celsius pitched yields up to 18%; the average savings account paid 0.06% (FDIC).
Voyager, Celsius and BlockFi all filed for bankruptcy in 2022. In Jan 2023 a judge ruled coins in Celsius Earn accounts belonged to Celsius; about 600,000 Earn accounts became unsecured creditors.
FDIC insurance covers bank deposits, not crypto. Since July 2025, the GENIUS Act bars stablecoin issuers from paying interest.
Sources: FDIC, US Bankruptcy Court SDNY, Bloomberg Law, GENIUS Act (P.L. 119-27).
